# 📦 Changelog — June 2026

> ⚠️ Tested on **LineageOS 23.2 / Android 16** only. Flash at your own risk.
> 📖 Full feature list: see the **README**.

---

## 🆕 What's New

- **KernelSU Next v3.3.0 (33214) with syscall table** — updated root + root hiding
- **Baseband Guard** — partition-tamper protection LSM (log-only for now)
- **USB Fast Charge** — now enabled by default (900mA, USB 2.0)
- **PELT half-life 16ms** — snappier scheduler/frequency response
- **Adrenoboost** + **Power-Efficient Workqueues** — GPU boost & battery savings
- **NTFS3** and **TMPFS XATTR / POSIX ACL**
- **nftables + ipset + IPv6 NAT** — modern firewall stack
- **iowait boost fix** + curated **YAKT** scheduler/VM tweaks

---

## 📝 Before Flashing
* Back up your stock **boot.img**, **vendor_boot.img** and **vendor_dlkm.img**
* Clean flash recommended for best stability

## 🐞 Bug Reports
- Include logs and clear reproduction steps
